id.historyP2: Perjalanan institusi ini ditandai dengan penguatan tata kelola akademik, peningkatan kolaborasi penelitian, serta perluasan jejaring dengan berbagai pemangku kepentingan di tingkat lokal, nasional, dan internasional.

id.ziPageLead: Informasi dan instrumen pendukung pembangunan Zona Integritas (ZI) di lingkungan Sekolah Pascasarjana UNIMA—transparan, akuntabel, dan bebas KKN.
id.ziIntroP1: Zona Integritas (ZI) merupakan konsep kebijakan untuk mewujudkan wilayah kerja yang bebas dari korupsi, kolusi, dan nepotisme (KKN), sekaligus memperkuat tata kelola yang baik (good governance) serta pelayanan yang bersih, transparan, dan akuntabel.
id.ziIntroP2: Melalui ZI, Pascasarjana UNIMA berkomitmen meningkatkan kepercayaan publik, memperkuat budaya integritas civitas akademika, dan menyelaraskan layanan dengan standar penjaminan mutu.
id.ziPillarsLead: Enam area strategis pembangunan Zona Integritas berbasis pendekatan sistemik.
id.ziGalleryLead: Cuplikan dokumentasi kegiatan pembangunan dan sosialisasi ZI di lingkungan pascasarjana.
id.ziComplaintLead: Saluran resmi untuk pengaduan, pelaporan pelanggaran, dan benturan kepentingan. Tautan eksternal dapat disesuaikan ke portal institusi.
id.ziUpdatesLead: Informasi terkini seputar ZI dan penjaminan mutu.
id.stopKorupsiLead: Komitmen Pascasarjana UNIMA untuk mencegah praktik korupsi dan memperkuat budaya integritas di seluruh layanan akademik dan administrasi.
id.stopKorupsiP1: Korupsi merugikan kualitas pendidikan, kepercayaan publik, dan keadilan. Di lingkungan perguruan tinggi, korupsi dapat muncul dalam bentuk penyalahgunaan wewenang, manipulasi data, pemerasan, hingga mark-up keuangan.
id.stopKorupsiP2: Setiap civitas akademika didorong mengenali risiko, menolak praktik tidak etis, serta melaporkan indikasi pelanggaran melalui saluran resmi yang tersedia.
id.stopKorupsiCtaP: Gunakan layanan aduan internal institusi atau portal nasional. Identitas pelapor dapat dilindungi sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku.
id.stopGratifikasiLead: Pencegahan gratifikasi ilegal guna menjaga netralitas jabatan, kehormatan institusi, dan kepercayaan mahasiswa serta masyarakat.
id.stopGratifikasiP1: Gratifikasi adalah pemberian kepada pegawai negeri atau penyelenggara negara dalam bentuk uang, barang, diskon, fasilitas, atau layanan lain yang berhubungan dengan jabatan—kecuali dikecualikan undang-undang.
id.stopGratifikasiP2: Di kampus, gratifikasi dapat berkaitan dengan penilaian, seleksi, pengadaan, atau layanan akademik. Menolak dengan sopan dan melaporkan merupakan bentuk perlindungan bersama.
id.stopGratifikasiCtaP: Jika Anda menerima atau diminta memberikan sesuatu yang berpotensi melanggar aturan, segera laporkan agar dapat ditindaklanjuti sesuai prosedur.

en.historyLead: The Graduate School of Manado State University was established to meet the need for advanced education and research development in Eastern Indonesia.
en.historyP1: Since its establishment, the UNIMA Graduate School has been committed to strengthening human resource quality through master’s and doctoral programs that are adaptive to scientific, technological, and societal developments.
en.historyP2: Its institutional journey is marked by stronger academic governance, expanded research collaboration, and broader partnerships with stakeholders at local, national, and international levels.

en.ziPageLead: Information and instruments supporting the Integrity Zone (IZ) at UNIMA Graduate School—transparent, accountable, and free from corruption, collusion, and nepotism.
en.ziIntroP1: The Integrity Zone is a policy concept for a work environment free of corruption, collusion, and nepotism (CCN), while strengthening good governance and clean, transparent, and accountable services.
en.ziIntroP2: Through the IZ, UNIMA Graduate School is committed to strengthening public trust, promoting integrity across the academic community, and aligning services with quality assurance standards.
en.ziPillarsLead: Six strategic areas for systemic Integrity Zone development.
en.ziGalleryLead: Selected documentation of IZ development and outreach activities at the graduate school.
en.ziComplaintLead: Official channels for complaints, violation reports, and conflicts of interest. External links can be updated to your institution’s portals.

en.stopKorupsiLead: UNIMA Graduate School’s commitment to preventing corrupt practices and strengthening integrity across academic and administrative services.
en.stopKorupsiP1: Corruption harms educational quality, public trust, and fairness. In higher education it may appear as abuse of authority, data manipulation, extortion, or financial irregularities.
en.stopKorupsiP2: All members of the academic community are encouraged to recognize risks, reject unethical practices, and report suspected violations through official channels.
en.stopKorupsiBulletsTitle: Risks in the graduate school environment
en.stopKorupsiCtaP: Use the institution’s internal complaint services or the national portal. Reporter identity may be protected under applicable regulations.
en.stopGratifikasiLead: Preventing illegal gratuities to safeguard neutrality, institutional dignity, and the trust of students and the public.
en.stopGratifikasiP1: Gratification means gifts to civil servants or state officials—including money, goods, discounts, facilities, or other benefits related to their position—unless exempted by law.
en.stopGratifikasiP2: On campus, gratification may relate to assessment, selection, procurement, or academic services. Politely declining and reporting helps protect everyone.
en.stopGratifikasiCtaP: If you are offered or asked for something that may violate the rules, report it promptly so it can be handled through proper procedures.

paragraphs.id: Assalamu'alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh. Selamat datang di portal Sekolah Pascasarjana UNIMA. Kami berkomitmen menjadikan pascasarjana sebagai ruang pengembangan ilmu, riset, dan profesionalitas yang relevan bagi pembangunan.
paragraphs.en: Welcome to the UNIMA Graduate School portal. We are committed to graduate education as a space for knowledge, research, and professionalism aligned with development needs.

paragraphs.id: Melalui berbagai program magister dan doktor, civitas akademika kami bersama-sama membangun budaya kolaborasi dan mutu layanan.
paragraphs.en: Through our master's and doctoral programmes, our academic community builds a culture of collaboration and quality service together.
